title: Latent-Lens: Visual Perception in Small Language Models Through Latent Communication
abstract: arXiv:2610.41751v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Bridging independent vision-language models (VLMs) and small language models (SLMs) in a modular multi-agent system typically forces them to exchange information as discrete text, which creates a lossy bottleneck for spatial and fine-grained details. This constraint is especially acute for SLMs, whose limited capacity makes them more reliant on the quality of the input signal. Recent latent-communication methods exchange states between language models. How a VLM can pass visual information to a separately pretrained text-only SLM though remains unexplored. We propose \textbf{Latent-Lens}, a lightweight codec that bridges the representation gap between a frozen VLM and a frozen SLM directly in latent space, enabling them to communicate purely through hidden states. translated_title: Latent-Lens：通过潜在通信实现小语言模型中的视觉感知
translated_abstract: 在模块化多智能体系统中，将独立的视觉语言模型（VLM）与小语言模型（SLM）进行桥接，通常迫使它们以离散文本形式交换信息，这在空间和细粒度细节方面造成了有损的信息瓶颈。这一限制对SLM尤为严峻，因为其有限的模型容量使其更加依赖输入信号的质量。最近的潜在通信方法实现了语言模型之间的状态交换，但VLM如何将视觉信息传递给单独预训练的纯文本SLM仍有待探索。我们提出了Latent-Lens，这是一种轻量级编解码器，直接在潜在空间中弥合冻结的VLM与冻结的SLM之间的表示差距，使两者能够纯粹通过隐藏状态进行通信。该编解码器由一个域编码器（将VLM的隐藏状态投影到SLM的嵌入空间）和一个形式化为LoRA的注意力解码器（教导SLM……）组成。
tldr: 提出轻量级编解码器Latent-Lens，让冻结的视觉语言模型通过潜在空间的隐藏状态直接与小语言模型通信，突破了传统离散文本交换带来的信息瓶颈。
en_tdlr: Latent-Lens is a lightweight codec that enables a frozen vision-language model to communicate visual information directly to a frozen small language model through latent hidden states, bypassing the lossy bottleneck of discrete text exchange.
